profile_text.body:
The Machine Intelligence Research Institute, or MIRI, is a nonprofit that describes itself as focused on preventing human extinction from artificial superintelligence. It is headquartered in Berkeley, California, and was founded in 2000. The organization says that for over two decades it has worked to understand and prepare for the challenges humanity will face in a transition to a world with artificial superintelligence, and that its technical and philosophical work helped found the field of AI alignment, with its researchers originating many of the theories and concepts central to current discussions of AI.

MIRI states that recent rapid advances at the frontier of artificial intelligence have dramatically shortened estimates of when superintelligence will arrive, and that technical progress on safety, alignment, and control has failed to keep up. In its account, humanity does not understand the internal workings of present systems well enough to completely control them or robustly steer their behavior, let alone the more powerful and complex systems it expects in coming years.

The organization's profile lists it as a nonprofit founded in 2000 and based in Berkeley, California. No lawsuits are listed against it.
